data.title: Nvidia and OpenAI in talks for up to $250 billion backstop to fund AI infrastructure plans
data.description: The backstop would let OpenAI raise debt for a data center campus in Pike County, Ohio, on the strength of Nvidia's credit.
data.author: Ashley Capoot,Kate Rooney
